headline: Follow the New Forest Code for a Responsible Visit
reservation: Check the official New Forest Code before visiting: keep your distance from free-roaming animals, keep to the tracks and avoid fires or BBQs. For individual walks, check the linked authority pages for current access details; accommodation bookings and live opening hours are not established by these excerpts.

days.title: Ancient Trees and Accessible Trails

stops.name: Blackwater Arboretum
stops.detail: Follow the short circular gravelled trail among conifers and tactile seed sculptures. Check the authority page for current access details.

stops.name: Brockenhurst Village
stops.detail: The official walk crosses grazed lawns and riverside woodlands and returns through the village to the railway station.

days.driving: Suggested pairing only; check the journey between each walking start before departure. Transfer times have not been verified.

days.title: Lakeside Wildlife and Forest Vistas

stops.name: Blashford Lakes
stops.detail: Explore bird hides connected by gravel paths. The nature reserve permits assistance dogs only; paths can be muddy in winter.

stops.name: Burley Village
stops.detail: The village-centre circular walk climbs gently along Castle Hill Lane and passes a hill fort before returning through the village.

days.driving: Suggested pairing only; check the journey between each walking start before departure. Transfer times have not been verified.

days.title: Ashurst Woodland and Boldre Countryside

stops.name: Ashurst Stroll
stops.detail: Start from Ashurst railway station for the official walk through open lawns, Churchplace Inclosure and Ashurst Wood. Woodland tracks and gates can be muddy.

stops.name: Boldre Village
stops.detail: Walk through country lanes, farmland and Roydon Woods Nature Reserve, returning alongside the Lymington River. Keep dogs on a lead.

intel.title: Walk-specific access
intel.text: Blashford Lakes permits assistance dogs only. Brockenhurst and Ashurst walks include road crossings and woodland tracks that can become muddy.

intel.title: Named walking starts
intel.text: Blackwater and Blashford Lakes have accessible parking bays according to their official walk pages. Current charges and capacity are not established; check before setting out.

intel.title: Walking pace
intel.text: Suggested start times are itinerary choices, not opening hours. The official Brockenhurst and Burley walk pages give a walking duration of 2–3 hours; check current access before departure.

intel.title: Connectivity not verified
intel.text: The reviewed authority excerpts do not establish mobile coverage at these walks. Save the official walk directions before departure rather than assuming reception.

intel.title: Fuel provision not verified
intel.text: The reviewed sources do not establish fuel-station locations or opening hours. Check your refuelling options independently before starting the journey.

plan.arrival: The official Brockenhurst walk starts at its railway station, and Ashurst Stroll also has a railway-station start. Verify current timetables and choose the walk start that suits your arrival.
plan.vehicle: Drivers should stay alert and slow down around free-roaming livestock. The reviewed sources do not establish rental or motorhome restrictions; check your provider and the actual roads before departure.
plan.goldenHour: For a suggested late-day walk at Blackwater Arboretum, check daylight and current access first. The sources describe the trees and trail but do not establish a specific sunset viewpoint or opening time.
